verifier_summary: Baidu: 1 reclassification (usm to functional, paged URLs only), 1 test fixed, 2 tests added, image filters live-confirmed via acjson; www/m HTML captcha-gated. Naver: 2 reclassifications (page, recent to non-functional), 1 test fixed, 3 tests added, all other functional rows live-confirmed or kept as plausible with notes.

paths: www.baidu.com/s (web results; also news vertical via tn=news, advanced search via tn=baiduadv)

www.baidu.com/baidu (legacy search endpoint used by site-search forms; accepts wd, word, ie, si, ct and returns results; confirmed by the LUS issue 831 maintainer comment comparing www.baidu.com/baidu?wd=X with ?ie=utf-8&wd=X)
m.baidu.com/s and m.baidu.com/<key=value>/.../s, where leading path segments such as from=844b, ssid=<hex>, pu=sz@1320_480, bd_page_type=0 are tracking/session/device segments to strip
m.baidu.com/sf/vsearch (mobile video vertical; inferred by analogy with www)
news.baidu.com/ns (legacy news search; now served via www.baidu.com/s?tn=news; inferred)
NOT result pages: www.baidu.com/link?url=... (outbound click redirect; AdGuard/LUS strip eqid and wd there), www.baidu.com/s?tn=json and image.baidu.com/search/acjson (JSON APIs)

functional.source: https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/master/searx/engines/baidu.py (images: word) ; https://github.com/ohblue/baidu-serp-api/blob/master/baidu_serp_api/baidu_mobile.py ; https://github.com/simonsww/edpx-zhixin/blob/master/env/app/view-ui/io/InputProcess.php

functional.name: pn
functional.meaning: Result offset, 0-based, in steps of rn (page 2 at 10 per page is pn=10).
functional.source: https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/master/searx/engines/baidu.py ; https://pypi.org/project/BaiduSpider/1.0.2.6/ (sdist __init__.py) ; Live A/B 2026-10-10 via image.baidu.com/search/acjson (backend of /search/index, which is captcha-gated), query fjord: pn=30 returned a different result set (Jaccard 0.015 against pn absent)

functional.name: rn
functional.meaning: Results per page; the advanced form offers 10, 20 or 50. Note LUS strips rn, which changes page size; keep it.
functional.source: https://www.baidu.com/gaoji/advanced.html ; https://github.com/searxng/searxng/blob/master/searx/engines/baidu.py

functional.name: ie
functional.meaning: Character encoding of the query (utf-8, utf8, gbk, gb2312). Required to decode a GBK-encoded wd/word correctly; Baidu's UI falls back to GBK detection, which mangles some UTF-8 input (confirmed by the LUS maintainer, who disabled the ie-removal rule for that reason).
functional.source: https://github.com/ohblue/baidu-serp-api/blob/master/baidu_serp_api/baidu_pc.py ; https://github.com/simonsww/edpx-zhixin/blob/master/env/app/view-ui/io/InputProcess.php (PS-INPUTENCODE, GBK fallback) ; https://github.com/DandelionSprout/adfilt/blob/master/LegitimateURLShortener.txt (commented-out ||baidu.com^$removeparam=ie, issue 831) ; https://github.com/DandelionSprout/adfilt/issues/831#issuecomment-1614339807 (maintainer: removing ie gives wrong results for certain characters, compare https://www.baidu.com/baidu?wd=%F0%9F%98%8E with ?ie=utf-8&wd=%F0%9F%98%8E)

functional.name: tn
functional.meaning: Overloaded. Functional ONLY when the value selects a vertical/template: news (news vertical on /s), baiduadv (advanced search, required by q1 to q6), baiduimage (image results), vsearch (video on /sf/vsearch). Every other value (baidu, baiduhome_pg, 48020221_dg, monline_3_dg, baidutop10, iphone, SE_*, *_pg, *_dg) is a partner/account code and is non-functional.
functional.source: https://github.com/simonsww/edpx-zhixin/blob/master/env/app/view-ui/io/InputProcess.php (tn mapped to PS-ORIACCOUNTNAME, i.e. originating account) ; https://www.baidu.com/gaoji/advanced.html (hidden tn=baiduadv) ; https://pypi.org/project/BaiduSpider/1.0.2.6/ (sdist __init__.py) (tn=news, tn=vsearch, tn=baiduimage)
functional.condition: keep only if value in {news, baiduadv, baiduimage, vsearch}

functional.name: usm
functional.meaning: Offset of back-end inserted results, carried on page-turn links so that page 2+ does not repeat or skip an inserted item. Baidu's own code says only page-turn searches need it ('后端插入结果偏移量, 仅翻页搜索需要此参数') and only emits it together with pn. Without pn (e.g. usm=1 on desktop related-search links) it does nothing. LUS strips it; do not copy that for paged URLs.
functional.source: https://github.com/simonsww/edpx-zhixin/blob/master/env/app/view-ui/baiduplugins/function.wiseMakeSearchUrl.php (doc comment, and usm only added when pn is non-empty) ; https://github.com/frankyZhang/User_Preference_Prediction/tree/master/SERP_baidu (saved SERPs: usm=1 on right-rail links without pn)

engines.notes: VERIFIED 2026-10-10. Baidu publishes no URL-parameter documentation; first-party evidence is the advanced-search form (re-fetched and confirmed: q1 to q4 text fields, rn 10/20/50, lm 0/1/7/30/360, ct 0 all languages / 1 simplified only / 2 traditional only, ft pdf/doc/xls/ppt/rtf/all, q5 anywhere/title/URL, q6 site, hidden tn=baiduadv) plus Baidu UI code mirrored in the 2014 edpx-zhixin dev environment (tn = originating account, f = come-from, ct = bitfield, nojc = cancel spelling hint, usm = paging offset, mobile path segments). Live checks: www.baidu.com/s, m.baidu.com/s and image.baidu.com/search/index all redirect unauthenticated clients to the wappass.baidu.com captcha even with BAIDUID cookies; www.baidu.com/sf/vsearch served two pages, then a security check, so the video vertical is not live-confirmed. image.baidu.com/search/acjson (the JSON endpoint the image page calls with the same parameter names) was reachable: z, imgratio, imgformat, ic, hd, latest, copyright, isImgSet, width/height, lm and pn were confirmed to change results; hot and face showed no change for one query and stay functional as plausible filters; ipn, ct, cl, fm, fr, st, oq, queryWord, nc, istype, se, showtab and fb were confirmed not to change results. Verifier changes: usm moved to functional, kept only with a non-zero pn (Baidu's own code says page-turn searches need it); width, height and image lm upgraded from inferred to confirmed; ie gained the LUS maintainer's breakage report; the /baidu legacy endpoint is now sourced; medium's 4get source corrected (4get defines the filter but does not send it); wenku parameter sources now note that BaiduSpider hits the gsearch endpoint. ClearURLs has no Baidu provider. AdGuard strips only rsv_pq, rsv_t and eqid; DandelionSprout's LUS is far more aggressive and also strips functional rn, lm (web, image and wenku), od, cl (news), usm (paged) and tn wholesale, so CheckLink must not copy LUS blindly; tn needs a value allowlist. Baidu has no safe-search, region/market or interface-language URL parameter (no source shows one); results language is ct (advanced) or sl_lang (search tools). Duplicate keys: if both wd and word appear, keep both. Empty-valued parameters (width=, height=, q3=) can be dropped. Keep gpc and other values byte-for-byte; do not re-encode. www.baidu.com/link?url=... is a redirect, not a canonical page.

engines.notes: VERIFIED 2026-10-10 by an independent live re-run. Most Naver parameter semantics come straight from Naver's own result-page source (option forms and their JS handlers), which counts as first-party; the official Search API docs (naver-openapi-guide news.md) confirm query and start semantics. Verifier A/B results (same URL with and without the parameter, result links or embedded image URLs compared; natural drift between two plain fetches was Jaccard 0.88 on news and 0.92 on integrated): confirmed functional: query, where, ssc, start (web tabs), nso, qvt, os/pkid/mra, news sort/pd+ds+de/photo/field/mynews group/service_area/docid+related, image section/res_fr+res_to/color/ccl/gif, video sort/period/playtime/dtype, kin answer, cafe cafe_where/st/date_option/prdtype. Confirmed non-functional: sm, tqi, oquery, acq, acr, acir, ackey, fbm, qdt, nso_open, mode, view, pq, stnm, x_csa, dtm_source, dtm_medium, buckets, referenceId, and two former functional rows now moved: page (start alone sets the offset) and recent (the period lives in nso). Kept as plausible: ie (no effect observed; Naver auto-detects UTF-8 and EUC-KR) and ptype (no effect for one query), plus the untested selected_cp/cp_bundle, date_from/date_to, srchby and mra2/eid/bid. The news and image tabs ignore start in their server-rendered first batch (they page by infinite scroll through s.search.naver.com), but start stays functional because the web-document tabs use it. ClearURLs has no Naver provider; AdGuard strips only tqi on result pages. Keep both where and ssc: blog and cafe tabs are chosen by ssc alone, older URLs and SearXNG use where alone. sort is overloaded: numeric for news, rel/date/playcount for video; st is the cafe sort. Naver has no safe-search, region or interface-language URL parameter: adult results are gated by login (4get). Empty-valued parameters (docid=, news_office_checked=, color=, date_from=) can be dropped.
